title: An IoT-Based QR-Code-Enabled Smart Medicine Box for Reducing Prescription Errors and Improving Medication Adherence
abstract: This work proposes an IoT-based smart medicine box that uses QR-code identification and real-time embedded sensing to reduce prescription errors and improve medication adherence. The system integrates sensor networks for biomedical monitoring with a real-time embedded controller to track dosage timing, verify prescriptions, and alert caregivers, aiming to close common gaps in at-home medication management.
